children: Addressing Pediatric ADHD Care Needs
The collaboration addresses two critical needs in pediatric ADHD care by combining objective brain function insights with a non-medication treatment alternative.
A 2024 study published in the Journal of Clinical Child & Adolescent Psychology revealed that approximately 7.1 million U.S. children have received an ADHD diagnosis.
Notably, nearly one-third of the estimated 6.5 million children with current ADHD receive no specific treatment, as many families actively seek alternatives to traditional stimulant medications.
Integrating AI Analytics And Non-Drug Therapy

Firefly’s Evoke platform combines quantitative electroencephalography and event-related potential testing with AI analytics, leveraging a proprietary database exceeding 200,000 brain scans to deliver objective data on individual brain function.

NeuroSigma’s prescription-only Monarch eTNS System is a palm-sized bioelectronic medical device that delivers mild external trigeminal nerve stimulation via a small forehead patch while a child sleeps.

Commercial Expansion And Partner Roles

NeuroSigma launched U.S. sales for its second-generation Monarch device in July 2026 after building a waitlist of over 1,500 patients, caregivers, and healthcare providers, subsequently expanding third-party installment payment options in September.
